ns2:section.sectionText: Please note: This section will have synchronous (live) sessions, to be held during the scheduled class day/time listed in Course Explorer. Register for the Online Lecture and one Online Discussion section. If all seats are full, check the cross-listed course pages first, then if needed complete the form at http://go.illinois.edu/NRESwaitinglist to be added to the waiting list. Students are required to log in and use Compass2g (compass2g.illinois.edu) and Zoom in order to complete this course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
